widget.name: VikEditor
widget.description: Medium-style block and inline WYSIWYG editor with bubble toolbar, slash commands, callouts, tables, and media embeds.

property.caption: Content Attribute
property.description: String attribute (preferably unlimited length) storing the HTML content of the editor.

property.defaultValue: Tell your story, or type '/' for commands...
property.caption: Placeholder Text
property.description: Empty canvas placeholder text shown when there is no content.

property.caption: Sync Mode
property.description: Determines when changes in the editor are committed back to the Mendix attribute.

property.caption: Debounce Delay (ms)
property.description: Milliseconds delay before committing keystrokes to Mendix when using Debounced mode.

property.caption: On change
property.description: Action (Nanoflow or Microflow) executed when the content changes and syncs.

property.caption: Typography Theme
property.description: Choose the visual typography style for the editor.

property.caption: Max Content Width
property.description: Maximum width of the writing canvas (e.g. 740px, 100%, 800px).

property.caption: Minimum Height
property.description: Minimum height of the editable area (e.g. 320px, 50vh).

property.caption: Inline Bubble Menu
property.description: Shows floating formatting toolbar when text is highlighted.

property.caption: Floating '+' Block Menu
property.description: Shows the '+' block insertion button on empty paragraph lines.

property.caption: Slash ('/') Commands
property.description: Allows typing '/' to quickly search and insert blocks.

property.caption: Syntax-highlighted Code Blocks
property.description: Enable code blocks with syntax highlighting and copy button.

property.caption: Tables
property.description: Enable table insertion and row/column manipulation.

property.caption: Callout / Alert Boxes
property.description: Enable colored info, tip, and warning banners.

property.caption: Task / Check Lists
property.description: Enable interactive to-do checkable items.

property.caption: Video Embeds
property.description: Enable responsive YouTube and Vimeo video embedding via URL.

property.caption: Image Support
property.description: Enable image embedding via URL, file upload, or drag-and-drop.

property.caption: Word (.docx) Import
property.description: Automatically convert uploaded or dropped Microsoft Word (.docx) documents into native blog blocks.

property.caption: Reading Stats Footer
property.description: Display word count, character count, and estimated reading time.

property.caption: Image Storage Mode
property.description: How uploaded or pasted image files should be handled.

enumerationValues.enumerationValue: URL Only (Prompt user for image web URL)

property.caption: On Image Upload Action
property.description: Nanoflow or Microflow called when an image is selected if using Custom Upload Mode.
